summary.text: Cathy Kott is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jason Ridley (R).
A registered nurse, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Cathy Kott earned an associate degree from Grayson College in 1988, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a 32-year resident of Whitfield near Cohutta, Georgia, a mother and grandmother, and a registered nurse for 37 years.
She wrote that she is running because she believes in steady leadership, open communication and working together.
Kott advanced from the Democratic primary for District 6 in 2024 and lost the general election to Ridley, receiving 14.7% of the vote to his 85.3%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary again on May 19, 2026.
